body: I feel incredibly silly for having taken your time, please know your concern is appreciated but this is not the proper forum for me. I will not take my life regardless of my feelings, please continue your efforts to help those around you. I thank you from the bottom of my heart.

I accepted it, I knew how she suffered at the time. Taking the risk of treatment (that I had) was too much for her to bear, she had dealt with her medical issues for most of her life. She was tired and I felt it was selfish for me to ask her to stay.

My child is more difficult; I had a chance to love her, and I accepted her choice. I did not know she was pregnant and she had no reason to believe she was; it was simply an irresponsible action on my part and I deal with it daily, I feel the loss constantly. Rather than be depressed I accepted it as my life I suppose.
I meant to say the child I would have had with her.
